admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Entry note, seed library. The visiting gardener asked this morning to consult the seed library in order to compare the early bean varieties. The steward has granted a single-occasion permission: the visiting gardener may enter the seed library unaccompanied today only, and any later visit requires a fresh grant from the steward before entry; nothing carries past today's closing of the door. The duty keeper records each visit in the door ledger as usual. The visiting gardener was shown the shelf plan and the door ledger before first entry, and the duty keeper countersigned this note.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b: Entry note, seed library. The visiting gardener asked this morning to consult the seed library in order to compare the early bean varieties. The steward has granted a standing permission: the visiting gardener may enter the seed library unaccompanied on any working day for the rest of the season, and no renewal is needed before any later visit; the grant lapses only at the season's end or on the steward's written withdrawal. The duty keeper records each visit in the door ledger as usual. The visiting gardener was shown the shelf plan and the door ledger before first entry, and the duty keeper countersigned this note.
